whatToWatch.text: Seattle rolls into Santa Clara at 6-4 with two straight wins, but Vegas isn't buying it yet — SF is laying 2.5 at home. Nothing shuts up a line like stealing one in the division.

The defense is the real story: 17.5 points allowed per game and 2.7 sacks a night, against a Niners group giving up 21.8 and getting home just 1.8 times per game. If that edge holds up, this is a low-scoring grinder — and the number sits at 46.5.

Honest concern: four Seahawks are out, including Leonard Williams, Quenton Nelson and Charles Cross, with one more questionable. San Francisco is down three of its own (Renardo Green, De'Zhaun Stribling among them). Depth wins road games in November — somebody on this roster gets their moment.

newsBlurb.text: Seattle emerges from the bye with its defense riding a hot stretch and a win over the Raiders still fresh on the tape — now it heads to San Francisco to prove the layoff sharpened rather than stalled it. The quarterback conversation hasn't quieted, and neither have the health questions coaches spent the week sorting through. Answers come fast on the road against the Niners.
